body.name: Everywhere-defined two-resolution clipped Hessian estimator
body.construction: For each \(p\in\mathcal A\), compute \(\widetilde f_p=Q_{k_n}P_{p,n_p}\) at \(k_n=h_n\ell_n^{-2/s}\) and \(\mathcal E_{p,n}=\{\inf_{D_p}\widetilde f_p\ge b/2,\ \lVert\widetilde f_p\rVert_{C^r(D_p)}\le2L\}\). Use \(\widehat f_p=\widetilde f_p\) on this event and \(\widehat f_p=f_p^{\circ}=\lvert D_p\rvert^{-1}\) otherwise. Solve the normalized Monge--Ampere problem, form \(\widetilde H_p=D^2(K_{h_n}\widehat\varphi_p)\), report \(\widehat H_p=\Pi_{m/4}(\widetilde H_p)\), and compute \(\widehat S_{pq}\) and \(\widehat\gamma_{pq}\) from the clipped fields. Thus every inverse exists on every sample.
